f.title: Perform national PV activities under the responsibility of the responsible pharmacist
f.statement: Pharmacovigilance activities and compliance with the pharmacovigilance obligations of any company exploiting medicinal products are carried out in France under the responsibility of the responsible pharmacist (pharmacien responsable).
f.clause: 4.2 (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)

rows.quote:
La mise en œuvre des activités de pharmacovigilance et du respect des obligations de
pharmacovigilance incombant à toute entreprise exploitant des médicaments, s’exerce sur le territoire
national sous la responsabilité du pharmacien responsable.

f.title: Where the national system is part of the EU system, document roles and interfaces
f.statement: Where the exploitant's national pharmacovigilance system is only part of the MAH's European system, the responsible pharmacist ensures that he or she can fully exercise all pharmacovigilance obligations; the roles and responsibilities of each and the operating arrangements between the systems are described in a specific document (content per 4.12).
f.clause: 4.3 (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)

rows.quote:
Lorsque le système de pharmacovigilance mis en œuvre par l’exploitant sur le territoire national
ne constitue qu’une partie du système de pharmacovigilance mis en œuvre par le titulaire de l’AMM au
niveau européen, le pharmacien responsable s’assure de pouvoir exercer pleinement l’ensemble des
obligations qui lui incombent en matière de pharmacovigilance. Les responsabilités et rôles de chacun
ainsi que les modalités de fonctionnement entre ces systèmes sont décrits dans un document spécifique
dont le contenu est précisé au paragraphe 4.12 du présent chapitre.

The responsibilities and roles of each party and the operating arrangements between these systems are described in a specific document whose content is specified in paragraph 4.12 of this chapter.

f.title: Have a PV reference person (RPV) in France: physician or pharmacist with PV experience
f.statement: To meet its pharmacovigilance obligations, the exploitant has, under Article R. 5121-164 CSP, the services of a pharmacovigilance reference person (RPV) on the national territory. The RPV, a physician or pharmacist, resides and carries out activities in France and must demonstrate experience in pharmacovigilance. The RPV may or may not be the same person as the EEA QPPV and/or the responsible pharmacist.
f.clause: 4.4a (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)

rows.quote:
Afin d’assurer les obligations et les responsabilités qui lui incombent en matière de
pharmacovigilance, l’exploitant dispose, conformément aux dispositions de l’article R. 5121-164 du
CSP, des services d’une personne de référence en matière de pharmacovigilance sur le territoire
national. Cette personne de référence, médecin ou pharmacien, réside et réalise ses activités en France
et doit justifier d’une expérience en matière de pharmacovigilance. Elle peut être distincte (ou non) de
la personne qualifiée responsable en matière de pharmacovigilance dans l’EEE (QPPV) et/ou du
pharmacien responsable (PR).

This reference person, a physician or pharmacist, resides and carries out his or her activities in France and must demonstrate experience in pharmacovigilance. He or she may (or may not) be distinct from the qualified person responsible for pharmacovigilance in the EEA (QPPV) and/or the responsible pharmacist (PR).

f.title: RPV: set up and manage the national PV system and oversee reporting, PSUR and RMS compliance
f.statement: Under Article R. 5121-164 CSP the RPV must in particular (a) set up and manage the pharmacovigilance system on the national territory and (b) oversee control of the system as a whole and compliance with the pharmacovigilance obligations, including reporting adverse reaction cases, submitting PSURs and implementing the risk management system.

f.title: Train all staff and contractors on PV and safety-information handling; keep training records
f.statement: The RPV ensures training per GVP Module I: training of all staff of the exploitant and any service provider involved in PV activities appropriate to their roles, and training of all company staff on what to do when they become aware of a safety problem (including off-label use). Training plans and records are kept and available for audit or inspection.

rows.quote:
Le RPV s’assure de la formation du personnel conformément aux dispositions du module I des
GVP, notamment :
- la formation de tous les membres du personnel de l’entreprise ou organisme exploitant et de
tout prestataire intervenant dans l’exécution des activités de pharmacovigilance en lien avec
leur fonction et leurs responsabilités ;
- une formation de tous les membres du personnel de l’entreprise ou organisme exploitant afin
qu’ils connaissent la conduite à tenir dès lors qu’ils ont connaissance d’un problème de sécurité
(y compris d’une utilisation non conforme aux termes de l’autorisation ou de l’enregistrement).

Les plans de formation et les dossiers de formation sont conservés et tenus à disposition en cas d'audit
ou d'inspection.

f.title: Record and process all suspected ADRs and special situations in a usable database
f.statement: Following GVP Module VI, the exploitant records and processes electronically, so as to build and maintain a usable database: every suspected adverse reaction or special situation without adverse reaction occurring in on- or off-label use, and any information or enquiry concerning exposure. Special situations include overdose, misuse, abuse, diversion, medication error, occupational exposure, interaction, quality defect or falsified medicines, exposure in pregnancy (with follow-up of outcome and children), paternal exposure, exposure during breastfeeding, suspected transmission of infectious agents and suspected lack of efficacy.

f.title: Recontact reporters, seek medical confirmation of patient reports, inform reporters and keep written records
f.statement: The exploitant (f) recontacts the reporter by any means and within appropriate timeframes to collect or complete the report; for reports from patients, it seeks medical documentation, if possible from the healthcare professional consulted (with the patient's consent) or from the patient; and adapts its methodology to optimise collection of missing data; (g) informs the reporter of the action taken on the report; (h) keeps all elements relating to collection and documentation of the case and ensures traceability of exchanges with the reporter; all information, including oral, must be recorded in writing, dated and archived.

b) toute utilisation non conforme à l’autorisation, non conforme au bon usage (cf. articles L. 5121-
14-3 et R. 5121-151 du CSP), selon les modalités décrites dans le guide de signalement par

site Internet de l’Agence ;

f.title: Inform the RPV early of any planned PV subcontracting or service agreement
f.statement: When the exploitant subcontracts all or part of its PV activities, or performs PV activities for other MAHs/exploitants, the RPV must be informed as soon as possible of any draft agreement so that the PV system can be adapted.

f.title: Keep a list of current contracts affecting PV, with products and territories
f.statement: The exploitant keeps a list of current contracts that may affect pharmacovigilance activities, stating the medicinal products and territories concerned.

f.statement: Where all or part of PV activities or management of the computerised systems used for PV data are outsourced, a written contract must be established (Art. R. 5124-47 4° CSP) between the contract giver and the subcontractor, clearly setting out each party's roles and obligations and the exchange of information needed for PV activities.

rows.actor: Exploitant (company exploiting the medicinal product in France) and/or marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote:
Lorsque tout ou partie des activités de pharmacovigilance et/ou tout ou partie de la gestion des
systèmes informatisés utilisés pour le traitement des données de pharmacovigilance est externalisé par
l’exploitant et/ou le titulaire d’AMM, un contrat écrit doit être établi, conformément aux dispositions de
l’article R. 5124-47 4° du CSP, entre le donneur d’ordre et le sous-traitant en vue de fixer clairement les
rôles et obligations de chaque partie ainsi que les modalités d’échange des informations nécessaires

rows.quote_en: Where all or part of the pharmacovigilance activities and/or all or part of the management of the computerised systems used for processing pharmacovigilance data is outsourced by the exploitant and/or the MAH, a written contract must be established, in accordance with Article R. 5124-47 4° CSP, between the contract giver and the subcontractor in order to clearly set the roles and obligations of each party as well as the arrangements for exchanging the information necessary to carry out the pharmacovigilance activities.

f.title: Assess subcontractor capability per a documented procedure and record results
f.statement: The contract giver assesses the subcontractor's ability to perform the tasks in line with regulations and good PV practices; the principles of this assessment are described in a procedure and the results recorded.
f.clause: 4.40 (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)

a) le donneur d’ordre évalue la capacité du sous-traitant à effectuer les tâches demandées dans
le cadre de la prestation conformément aux exigences de la réglementation en vigueur et des
bonnes pratiques de pharmacovigilance. Les principes de cette évaluation sont décrits dans
une procédure et les résultats enregistrés ;

f.statement: The subcontractor must have a quality assurance and control system, accept audits by the contract giver, and provide guarantees on the security, integrity, confidentiality and accessibility of the PV data it processes (access for the contract giver during the contract and return of all data, including when it hosts systems, at the end of the contract); it may not subcontract the work to a third party without the contract giver's prior assessment and written agreement.

f.title: Outsourcing does not transfer responsibility for PV obligations
f.statement: The contract cannot have the effect or purpose of exonerating the exploitant and/or MAH from responsibility for performing its pharmacovigilance obligations.
f.clause: 4.41 (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)

f.title: When performing PV for other companies, define roles in a written contract and share benefit-risk information
f.statement: Where the exploitant performs PV activities on behalf of other exploitants and/or MAHs, a written contract must clearly state each party's roles and obligations; each party must ensure that any information that could call into question the benefit-risk evaluation of the product covered is transmitted to it.
f.clause: 4.42 (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)

d’autres exploitants et/ou titulaires d’AMM, un contrat écrit doit indiquer clairement les rôles et
obligations de chacune des parties au regard des dispositions législatives et réglementaires applicables.

4.43. Chaque partie doit notamment s’assurer que toute information susceptible de remettre en cause
l’évaluation du rapport entre les bénéfices et les risques du médicament faisant l’objet de l’accord lui
est transmise.

Each party must in particular ensure that any information likely to call into question the evaluation of the benefit-risk balance of the medicinal product covered by the agreement is transmitted to it.

f.title: Establish and maintain a documented PV quality system
f.statement: The exploitant sets up and maintains a quality system for PV activities per Article 8 of Implementing Regulation (EU) 520/2012 and GVP Module I; all elements must be documented in a structured way, notably via quality policy, quality manual(s) where relevant, written procedures and records.
f.clause: 4.44 (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)
f.legal_basis: Implementing Regulation (EU) 520/2012 Art. 8; GVP Module I

rows.quote:
L’exploitant met en place et maintient un système qualité pour l’exécution des activités de
pharmacovigilance, conformément aux exigences décrites à l’article 8 du règlement d’exécution (UE)
n°520/2012 précité et au module I des GVP, afin d’assurer le bon fonctionnement et la maîtrise efficace
de celles-ci. Tous les éléments, exigences et dispositions adoptés pour le système qualité doivent être
documentés de manière structurée au travers notamment de la politique qualité, de manuel(s) qualité
le cas échéant, de procédures écrites et d’enregistrements.

rows.quote_en: The exploitant sets up and maintains a quality system for performing pharmacovigilance activities, in accordance with the requirements of Article 8 of Implementing Regulation (EU) No 520/2012 and GVP Module I, in order to ensure their proper functioning and effective control. All elements, requirements and provisions adopted for the quality system must be documented in a structured manner, in particular through the quality policy, quality manual(s) where applicable, written procedures and records.

f.title: Maintain procedures describing the national PV system organisation and activities
f.statement: The exploitant has procedures describing the organisation and activities of the national PV system, in line with Article 11 of Implementing Regulation (EU) 520/2012 and GVP Module I.
f.clause: 4.45 (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)

rows.quote:
L’exploitant dispose de procédures décrivant l’organisation et les activités du système de
pharmacovigilance mis en place sur le territoire national. Ces procédures sont conformes aux
dispositions de l’article 11 du règlement d’exécution (UE) n°520/2012 précité et au module I des GVP.

f.title: Monitor PV system performance with indicators; document quality control and manage non-conformities
f.statement: The exploitant and/or MAH sets up a process for steering the PV system and its quality system per GVP Module I using performance indicators (Art. 9 of Regulation 520/2012). Indicators and quality control operations must be documented and archived, and any non-conformity or deviation managed as described.
f.clause: 4.46 (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)

rows.actor: Exploitant (company exploiting the medicinal product in France) and/or marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote:
L’exploitant et/ou le titulaire d’AMM met en place un processus de pilotage du système de
pharmacovigilance et de son système qualité tel que défini dans le module I des GVP, utilisant
notamment des indicateurs de résultats, conformément aux exigences de l’article 9 du règlement
d’exécution (UE) n° 520/2012 précité. Les indicateurs et opérations de contrôle qualité mis en place
pour vérifier la bonne exécution des activités de pharmacovigilance doivent être documentés et archivés
et toute non-conformité ou déviation identifiée doit faire l’objet d’une gestion telle que décrite ci-après.

The indicators and quality control operations put in place to verify the proper performance of pharmacovigilance activities must be documented and archived and any non-conformity or deviation identified must be managed as described below.

f.title: Detect and record deviations and run CAPA under RPV supervision
f.statement: The exploitant and/or MAH detects and records deviations and carries out the resulting corrective and preventive actions; this is supervised and controlled by the RPV and performed by those in charge of the PV quality system. This also applies to any organisation performing PV activities on their behalf.

que la réalisation des actions correctives et préventives qui en résultent. Cette activité est supervisée
et contrôlée par le RPV et est réalisée par les personnes en charge du système qualité applicable à
l’exécution des activités de pharmacovigilance.

f.title: Audit PV activities with qualified, independent auditors
f.statement: The exploitant performs audits per Article 13 of Implementing Regulation (EU) 520/2012, GVP Module IV and Article R. 5121-162 CSP; auditors' training, qualification and experience comply with Module IV and are recorded; auditors are independent of the activities audited.

(UE) n° 520/2012 précité, au module IV des GVP et à l’article R.5121-162 du CSP.

des GVP et font l’objet d’un enregistrement. Les auditeurs sont indépendants des activités auditées.

rows.quote_en: c) in response to the audit report, after its distribution to the persons concerned, the RPV in agreement with the entity in charge of the quality system defines a corrective and preventive action plan and its implementation deadlines. The action plan is approved by the PR and sent to the auditors. The PR and the RPV ensure follow-up and closure of the action plan. Evidence of resolution of the actions is recorded. Follow-up audits are carried out if necessary;

f.title: Share foreign audit findings that may breach French rules with the RPV and responsible pharmacist
f.statement: Where major or critical deviations in PV activities performed outside France may cause a deviation from national regulations, the relevant part of the audit report must be sent to the RPV and PR, with documentation of CAPA follow-up and closure.
f.clause: 4.49d (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)
f.processes: Quality system & CAPA; Local PV interfaces

rows.quote:
d) lorsque des déviations majeures ou critiques concernant des activités de pharmacovigilance
réalisées dans un pays autre que la France peuvent engendrer une déviation à la
réglementation nationale, la partie d’intérêt du rapport d’audit correspondant doit être transmise
au RPV et au PR ainsi que la documentation du suivi et de la clôture des actions correctives et
préventives.

f.title: Retain all PV data for the life of the MA and at least 10 years after expiry
f.statement: The exploitant and the MAH must each, for their part, retain all pharmacovigilance data for the whole validity of the MA and for at least 10 years after its expiry, per Article 12 of Implementing Regulation (EU) 520/2012.
f.clause: 4.51 (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)

rows.deadline: MA validity plus at least 10 years
rows.quote:
L’exploitant et le titulaire d’AMM sont tenus de conserver, chacun pour ce qui le concerne, toutes
les données de pharmacovigilance pendant toute la durée de validité de l’AMM et pendant au moins 10
ans après l’expiration de celle-ci conformément aux exigences de l’article 12 du règlement d’exécution
(UE) n°520/2012 précité.
rows.location: 4.51 (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The exploitant and the MAH are required to retain, each for its own part, all pharmacovigilance data throughout the period of validity of the MA and for at least 10 years after its expiry, in accordance with Article 12 of Implementing Regulation (EU) No 520/2012.

f.title: Protect personal data in PV under the French Data Protection Act and the CNIL vigilance reference framework
f.statement: The exploitant and MAH guarantee confidentiality of personal data, notably patient and reporter identities, in processing health data for PV, in particular complying with Law 78-17 of 6 January 1978 and the CNIL reference framework for processing personal data for health vigilance (deliberation 2019-057 of 9 May 2019).
f.clause: 4.53 (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)

rows.quote:
L’expoitant et le titulaire d’AMM garantissent le respect de la confidentialité des données à caractère
personnel, notamment l’identité des patients et des déclarants, dont ils ont connaissance dans le cadre
de la gestion des données de santé recueillies pour l’exercice de la pharmacovigilance. Il s’agit
notamment de respecter les dispositions de la loi n°78-17 du 6 janvier 1978 modifiée relative à
l’informatique, aux fichiers et aux libertés et du référentiel relatif aux traitements de données à caractère
personnel mis en œuvre à des fins de gestion des vigilances sanitaires introduit par la délibération
n°2019-057 du 9 mai 2019 de la CNIL.
rows.location: 4.53 (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)
rows.review_note: Review: national addition (CNIL reference framework). Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; French normative present indicative in an ANSM decision (binding under the CSP, sanctionable per 4.56) = Mandatory; 'doit' = Mandatory; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The exploitant and the MAH guarantee respect for the confidentiality of personal data, in particular the identity of patients and reporters, of which they become aware in managing the health data collected for pharmacovigilance. This involves in particular complying with Law No 78-17 of 6 January 1978 as amended on data processing, files and freedoms and with the reference framework for the processing of personal data for the management of health vigilance introduced by CNIL deliberation No 2019-057 of 9 May 2019.

f.title: Ensure business continuity of critical PV activities
f.statement: The exploitant and/or MAH takes the measures needed to ensure continuity of critical activities per Article 10(4) of Implementing Regulation (EU) 520/2012 and GVP Module I.
f.clause: 4.54 (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)

rows.actor: Exploitant (company exploiting the medicinal product in France) and/or marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote:
L’exploitant et/ou le titulaire d’AMM prend les dispositions nécessaires pour assurer la continuité
des activités critiques conformément aux exigences de l’article 10(4) du règlement d’exécution (UE)
n°520/2012 précité au module I des GVP.
rows.location: 4.54 (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; French normative present indicative in an ANSM decision (binding under the CSP, sanctionable per 4.56) = Mandatory; 'doit' = Mandatory; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The exploitant and/or the MAH takes the necessary measures to ensure the continuity of critical activities in accordance with Article 10(4) of Implementing Regulation (EU) No 520/2012 and GVP Module I.

f.title: Control the computerised systems used for PV
f.statement: The exploitant and/or MAH puts in place arrangements to ensure control of the computerised systems used for PV activities per GVP Module I.
f.clause: 4.55 (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)
f.processes: Validation & change control; Safety system configuration

rows.actor: Exploitant (company exploiting the medicinal product in France) and/or marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote:
L’exploitant et/ou le titulaire d’AMM mettent en place des dispositions permettant d’assurer la
maîtrise des systèmes informatisés utilisés dans le cadre de l’exécution des activités de
pharmacovigilance conformément aux dispositions du module I des GVP.
rows.location: 4.55 (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; French normative present indicative in an ANSM decision (binding under the CSP, sanctionable per 4.56) = Mandatory; 'doit' = Mandatory; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The exploitant and/or the MAH put in place arrangements to ensure control of the computerised systems used in performing pharmacovigilance activities in accordance with GVP Module I.

f.title: Non-compliance with PV obligations and these good practices is subject to financial sanctions
f.statement: Failure to comply with the pharmacovigilance obligations of MAHs and/or exploitants and with these good practices is liable to financial sanctions under point 1.33 (Articles L. 5312-4-1 and L. 5471-1 CSP).
f.clause: 4.56 (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)

rows.actor: Exploitant (company exploiting the medicinal product in France) and/or marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote:
La méconnaissance des obligations qui incombent aux titulaires d’AMM et/ou aux exploitants en
matière de pharmacovigilance ainsi que la méconnaissance des présentes bonnes pratiques est
passible de sanction financière prononcées selon les modalités décrites au point 1.33 des présentes
bonnes pratiques.
rows.location: 4.56 (Chapitre 4 : Rôle du titulaire et de l’exploitant)
rows.review_note: Review: sanction provision (consequence, not a stand-alone duty); kept because it makes the whole chapter enforceable. Double-check: 88.
rows.quote_en: Failure to comply with the pharmacovigilance obligations incumbent on MAHs and/or exploitants and failure to comply with these good practices is liable to financial sanctions imposed under the arrangements described in point 1.33 of these good practices.

f.title: Provide ANSM on request with benefit-risk data, sales, stock, prescription and use data
f.statement: The ANSM Director General may at any time ask the MAH and/or exploitant to transmit all data demonstrating that the benefit-risk balance remains favourable, and any information on sales volume, stock status, prescription volume and prescribing and use practices.
f.clause: 1.12 (Chapitre 1 : Rôle de l’ANSM)

rows.actor: Exploitant (company exploiting the medicinal product in France) and/or marketing authorisation holder
rows.quote:
Le Directeur général de l’agence peut demander à tout moment, au titulaire et/ou l'exploitant de
l’AMM d’un médicament, la transmission de toutes les données permettant de démontrer que le rapport
entre les bénéfices et les risques de ce médicament demeure favorable ainsi que toute information
relative au volume des ventes, à l’état des stocks, au volume des prescriptions et aux pratiques de
prescription et d’utilisation.
rows.location: 1.12 (Chapitre 1 : Rôle de l’ANSM)
rows.review_note: Review: worded as an ANSM power; the company duty to respond is implied (and stated for the RPV in 4.8). National addition: stock status. Double-check: 85.
rows.quote_en: The Director General of the agency may at any time ask the MAH and/or exploitant of a medicinal product to transmit all data demonstrating that the benefit-risk balance of the medicinal product remains favourable as well as any information relating to sales volume, stock status, prescription volume and prescribing and use practices.

f.title: National PV survey (enquête nationale): provide the data requested in the ANSM opening letter on time
f.statement: When ANSM opens a national pharmacovigilance survey, it sends the MAH(s) or exploitant(s) an opening letter specifying the survey's conduct, scope and objectives and, where applicable, the list of data to be provided, the deadlines and the means of sending; the rapporteur may also request any additional information in writing during the survey (6.7).
f.clause: 6.4 (Chapitre 6 : Enquête nationale de pharmacovigilance)

rows.actor: Exploitant (company exploiting the medicinal product in France) and/or marketing authorisation holder
rows.deadline: As set in the ANSM opening letter
rows.quote:
Un courrier d’ouverture de l’enquête est également adressé par l’ANSM au(x) titulaire(s) d’AMM ou
exploitant(s) du ou des médicaments objet(s) de l’enquête. Ce courrier précisera notamment les
modalités du déroulement de l’enquête, son périmètre, ses objectifs ainsi que, le cas échéant, la liste
des données devant être fournies, les délais impartis et les modalités d’envoi.
rows.location: 6.4 (Chapitre 6 : Enquête nationale de pharmacovigilance)
rows.review_note: Review: national addition (French national PV survey). The company duty to supply the listed data within the deadlines is implied by the letter's content ('données devant être fournies, les délais impartis'). Double-check: implied duty, so below 90.
rows.quote_en: A letter opening the survey is also sent by ANSM to the MAH(s) or exploitant(s) of the medicinal product(s) subject to the survey. This letter will specify in particular the arrangements for conducting the survey, its scope, its objectives and, where applicable, the list of data to be provided, the time limits and the arrangements for sending.

f.title: Make safety communications clear, objective, balanced and non-promotional per GVP Module XV
f.statement: Communication on the safety of medicinal products follows GVP Module XV principles: clear and adapted to recipients; objective and not misleading; always presents risk in the perspective of the expected benefit; states uncertainties; preceded where possible by consultation of patients and HCPs; consistent and coordinated; respects data protection and confidentiality; followed where possible by impact evaluation; and must have no promotional character.
f.clause: 7.1 (Chapitre 7 : Bonnes pratiques de communication)

rows.actor: All communicators, including MAH and exploitant
rows.location: 7.1 (Chapitre 7 : Bonnes pratiques de communication)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; French normative present indicative in an ANSM decision (binding under the CSP, sanctionable per 4.56) = Mandatory; 'doit' = Mandatory; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: Communication on the safety of use of medicinal products follows the principles set out in GVP Module XV, in particular communication: - is clear and adapted to the recipients to meet their expectations; - is presented objectively and not misleadingly; - always presents the risk in perspective of the expected benefit; - states any uncertainties; - is preceded, if possible, by consultation of patients and healthcare professionals, particularly when the situation is complex; - is consistent and coordinated between the various actors concerned; - takes account of regulatory requirements on protection of individual data and confidentiality; - is followed, if possible and in view of the risk identified, by an evaluation of its impact; - must not have any promotional character.

f.title: Inform the competent authorities (and EMA and Commission if multi-country) before disseminating PV information
f.statement: The MAH or exploitant informs the national competent authority(ies) of its intention to disseminate pharmacovigilance information, and also EMA and the European Commission if the product is authorised in several Member States.
f.clause: 7.8 (Chapitre 7)

rows.quote:
Le titulaire d’AMM ou l’exploitant informe la ou les autorités nationales compétentes de son intention
de diffuser une information de pharmacovigilance, ainsi que l’EMA et la Commission européenne s’il
s’agit d’un médicament autorisé dans plusieurs États.
rows.location: 7.8 (Chapitre 7)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; French normative present indicative in an ANSM decision (binding under the CSP, sanctionable per 4.56) = Mandatory; 'doit' = Mandatory; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: The MAH or the exploitant informs the national competent authority(ies) of its intention to disseminate pharmacovigilance information, as well as EMA and the European Commission if the medicinal product is authorised in several States.

f.title: Send draft PV communications to ANSM in advance; ANSM may change content or timing
f.statement: When it wishes to disseminate pharmacovigilance information, the MAH or exploitant sends its draft communications to ANSM in advance; ANSM reserves the right to have the content and/or timetable changed.
f.clause: 7.9 (Chapitre 7)

rows.quote:
Lorsqu’il souhaite diffuser une information de pharmacovigilance, le titulaire d’AMM ou l’exploitant
transmet à l’ANSM au préalable ses projets de communication. L’ANSM se réserve le droit de faire
modifier le contenu et ou le calendrier.
rows.location: 7.9 (Chapitre 7)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; French normative present indicative in an ANSM decision (binding under the CSP, sanctionable per 4.56) = Mandatory; 'doit' = Mandatory; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: When it wishes to disseminate pharmacovigilance information, the MAH or the exploitant sends its draft communications to ANSM beforehand. ANSM reserves the right to have the content and/or the timetable modified.

f.title: Follow the authorities' communication plan and messages when communicating at their request
f.statement: When communicating at the request of the competent authorities, the MAH and/or exploitant follows the communication plan and messages they require.
f.clause: 7.10 (Chapitre 7)

rows.quote:
Lorsqu’il communique à la demande des autorités compétentes, le titulaire et/ou l’exploitant
respecte le plan de communication et les messages demandés par celles-ci.
rows.location: 7.10 (Chapitre 7)
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; French normative present indicative in an ANSM decision (binding under the CSP, sanctionable per 4.56) = Mandatory; 'doit' = Mandatory; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: When it communicates at the request of the competent authorities, the holder and/or the exploitant complies with the communication plan and the messages requested by them.

f.title: DHPC: use the ANSM template, get ANSM validation (incl. translations of EU DHPCs) and follow national distribution and funding rules
f.statement: For a Direct Healthcare Professional Communication (DHPC), the MAH or exploitant uses the current DHPC template on the ANSM website; when the communication is decided nationally, submits the draft letter to ANSM for validation; when the DHPC is drafted at EU level, also follows the GVP Module XV template and submits the draft translation to ANSM for validation before sending; and follows the nationally defined distribution arrangements and the industry funding rules in the ANSM-LEEM/GEMME/NERES agreement.
f.clause: 7.11 (Chapitre 7)

rows.quote:
Dans le cas d’une diffusion d’une lettre aux professionnels de santé (DHPC pour Direct Health
Care Professional Communication comme prévu au module XV des GVP) :
- il respecte le modèle de DHPC en vigueur disponible sur le site internet de l’ANSM ;
- lorsque la communication est décidée au niveau national, il soumet le projet de courrier à
l’ANSM pour validation ;
- lorsque le projet de DHPC est élaboré au niveau européen, il, respecte également le modèle
de DHPC défini dans le module XV des GVP et il soumet le projet de traduction à l’ANSM
pour validation avant envoi ;
- il respecte les modalités de diffusion définies au niveau national ainsi que les règles de
portage financier par les industriels décrites dans la convention entre l’ANSM et les
organisations professionnelles de l’industrie (LEEM/GEMME/NERES).
rows.location: 7.11 (Chapitre 7)
rows.review_note: Review: national additions (ANSM DHPC template, validation of French translation, industry funding convention). Review: no change. Double-check: quote proves actor, duty and modal force; French normative present indicative in an ANSM decision (binding under the CSP, sanctionable per 4.56) = Mandatory; 'doit' = Mandatory; statement adds nothing beyond the quote. Bilingual review: independent re-translation agrees with quote_en in meaning and modal force.
rows.quote_en: In the case of distribution of a letter to healthcare professionals (DHPC, Direct Health Care Professional Communication as provided for in GVP Module XV): - it complies with the current DHPC template available on the ANSM website; - when the communication is decided at national level, it submits the draft letter to ANSM for validation; - when the draft DHPC is drawn up at European level, it also complies with the DHPC template defined in GVP Module XV and submits the draft translation to ANSM for validation before sending; - it complies with the distribution arrangements defined at national level and the rules on financial responsibility by industry described in the agreement between ANSM and the industry professional organisations (LEEM/GEMME/NERES).
